tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /phag mo'i sbyin sreg shin tu bsdus pa bzhugs/

phag mo'i sbyin sreg shin tu bsdus pa ni/ dkyil 'khor chos 'byung gi dbus su padma'i 'dab brgyad yod pa lte ba la gri gug bris te/ dmar po la dkar pos bcad rgyab che chung khru gang ba bya/ lci ba gong de dang mthun par brtsigs pa'am zlum por brtsigs pa gang bde bya/ gtor ma che chung gnyis sngon 'gro gtor ma mchod pa nang mchod/ dpal 'bar yam shing til mar khu 'bru sna tshogs ba glang gi sha skam po la nang mchod bdud rtsi'i ril bu sbyar ba byugs pa'i mthe chung gi mgo tsam mang po bshams/ sngon 'gro gtor ma nas bdag bskyed bzlas pa dang bcas pa'i bar gzhung bzhin bya/ sreg rdzas rnams sumbha sa bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ lan brgya tsam gyis byin gyis brlabs/ thab bsangs sbyangs stong pa'i ngang las bhruṃ las byung ba'i thab khung gru gsum dmar po kha khyer dang mu ran dang stegs bu bcas pa/ nang lha rdzas kyi bud shing gis gang ba/ oṃ badzra dzwa la hūṃ/ dpal 'bar me tshang du bcug / thab nang 'bar ba'i me'i dbus su/ e e las zhes pa nas/ oṃ yo ga shuddho3haṃ gi bar bdun bskyed bzhin/ sku'i g.yon du me lha dmar po bgrang 'phreng spyi blugs 'dzin pa ra skyes la bzhon pa/ 'bar ba'i 'phreng ba 'khrugs pa bzhugs par gyur/ dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ de nas dang po mar khu dgang blugs gsum phul te/ oṃ gsum ma'i mthar/ oṃ agna ye swāhā/ lan gsum/ oṃ agna ye a dī bhyaḥ a bhi sha a bhi sha mahā shrī ye ha bya ka bya bā ha na ye swāhā/ zhes brjod/ de nas dwangs shing dri med nas bstod pa'i bar bya/ bsdu na tshigs bcad bor/ sngags kyi skabs/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badzra yo gī ni sa pa ri wā re bhyaḥ mahā agne de ba ta sa pa ri wā re bhyaḥ arghaṃ pra tītstsha sāhā/ zhes sogs thams cad la sbyar ro/ /gtso mo'i bstod pa'i mthar/ 'jig rten dbang phyug tshangs dbang mgon gyi sras/

/me lha'i rgyal po ṭākkis dbang bskur ba/ /shes rab mchog gi nyon mongs thams cad sreg /'jigs byed me lha nyid la rnam par 'dud/ / bdag la dngos grub stsal du gsol/ / de nas oṃ gsum ma la/ oṃ agna ye swāhā zhes btags/ a dī bya sogs sbyar la/ mar khu lan bdun tsam phul ba dang*/ oṃ bo dhi brikṣa ya swāhā sbyar bas yam shing*/ oṃ badzra bi dza ya swāhā sbyar bas 'bru sna tshogs phul/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badzra swāhā/ sbyar bas til lan bdun phul/ dngos gzhi oṃ gsum ma kho na bzla zhing*/ til phul te grangs 'dzin thun gyi mjug tu ba glang gi sha brgya tsam phul la/ oṃ gsum ma brgya tham pa dang sbyar/ de nas rnal 'byor ma'i gtor bsngo dang*/ a kā ro lan bdun gyis me lha la phul/ de nas cho ga'i mjug gi rjes chog de ka bya ba las/ khyad par ni/ ye shes pa gshegs pa'i rjes la thal ba cung zad cig dpral bar skud/ 'jig rten pa'i me lha mi dmigs par gyur/ zhes brjod pa'o/ /me ma shi bar mi dkrug go /zhes pa 'di nye gnas zer ba'i rtogs ldan gyi don du/ tā ra nā thas bris/ dar rgyas 'phel/ /maṅga laṃ/ dge'o// mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/phag mo'i sbyin sreg shin tu bsdus pa bzhugs/ - PAGE 46 -- PAGE 45 -- PAGE 45 -
